rule.scope: New user hypothesis: topology is useful under a strict small-neural-model budget; not a claim over unconstrained networks.
rule.timing: After MLP exploration, while compact CNN grid remains running; before reading unused official wdep member. Primary512budget was declared before all tiny MLP fits.
rule.development: Official TRA1934/CV946; keep all completed feasible MLP configurations and all registered compactCNN configurations.
rule.selection: Global best topology and global best non-topology by mean3seed CVaccuracy, then meanCE, fewer parameters, lexical family+id. No selection on TEST.
rule.refit: All2880TRA+CV, same selected optimizer and architecture; fixed median3development-selected epochs. Refit all scalers on fullTRAIN; no further stopping/tuning.
rule.held_out: optdigits-orig.wdep.Z,943images from writers already represented in training. Previously excluded from this research. This is a new-image test, NOT a new-writer test.
rule.primary: Mean accuracy of individual <=512parameter models across10fixed seeds. No ensemble classifier; deploying one network uses its single-model weight count.
rule.uncertainty: Paired image sign-flip test on10seed-averaged per-image correctness differences; crossed paired-seed/image bootstrap95% CI. Images, not seed-image pairs, are permutation units. Writer identities unavailable, so no writer-independent confidence claim.
rule.multiple_testing: Bonferroni6: old OptDigits-windep, PenDigits, CharacterTrajectories, USPS, RIM-ONE DL and this new OptDigits-wdep comparison. p_adjusted=min(1,6*p). Any prior5test family claim needs reevaluation at6for a combined-series claim.
rule.success: Positive mean accuracy difference, adjustedp<=.05, crossed-bootstrap95% lower bound>0, at least8/10positive seed pairs. Report failures. No SOTA/priority or total-latency reduction inferred from fewer trained weights.

exact_test_amendment.timing: Before any WDEPaccess and before final configuration/weights freeze; CNN development still running.
exact_test_amendment.change: Compute the same paired-image sign-flip test exactly by dynamic programming on integer10seed correctness sums, replacing the planned Monte Carlo approximation. No change to hypothesis, statistic, unit, direction oralpha.
exact_test_amendment.reason: Integer correctness differences permit an exact finite weighted-Rademacher tail. Avoid Monte Carlo uncertainty at the rejection threshold.
exact_test_amendment.checks: Known5image all-positive tail1/32; zero effects1; balanced pair.75; duplicated10seeds on one image stillp=.5; arbitraryweighted case matches exhaustiveenumeration.
exact_test_amendment.assumptions: Conditional exactness under paired algorithm-exchangeability at image level. Repeated writers are not identified, so this does not establish writer-independent inference.

secondary_curve_amendment.timing: Before any WDEP TEST access and before final freeze; after exploratory MLP size curve, while CNN controls run.
secondary_curve_amendment.primary: Unchanged: global best topology versus global best non-topology under512weights.
secondary_curve_amendment.secondary: Also refit the six TRAIN/CV-selected MLP configurations at256/1024/2048weights,10seeds each, to report a fixed held-out capacity curve. These are descriptive secondary points and cannot replace a failed512primary test or support independent significance claims.
secondary_curve_amendment.reason: Show whether the apparent dependence on size survives on held-out images; do not infer it only from exploratory CV.
